item.title: AWS Quick adds Meta ads AI connector for marketing workflows
item.description:
AWS Quick adds Meta ads AI connector for marketing workflows

AWS Quick has added a Meta ads AI connector, enabling marketers to create, manage, and analyze campaigns using natural language while staying connected to the Meta ad management network.

🔍 Overview

The connector addresses the friction of manual data handling in marketing teams. Previously, data such as campaign results, creative assets, and inventory lived in separate systems like Meta Ads Manager, shared storage, and data lakes. Analysts often had to export reports and manually update campaigns, leading to slow insights. With the new connector, marketing teams can use one place to go from campaign planning to execution, acting on business insights directly in their ads without tool switching.

🧩 How it works

The Meta ads AI connector gives AWS Quick access to ads Model Context Protocol (MCP) server operations. Installation involves navigating to Customize > Connectors in AWS Quick, signing in with Facebook, and selecting which Pages, Businesses, and Instagram accounts AWS Quick can access. Once connected, users can interact with the system via natural language prompts. The system can combine Meta ad management data with first- and third-party data sources to generate dashboards, documents, slide decks, and automated workflows. It also integrates with fal.ai’s image, audio, and video models within the same workflow to test creative ideas.

⚙️ Key details

The connector supports specific capabilities for managing ad lifecycle tasks:

  • Plan and launch campaigns: Drafts campaign, ad set, and ad settings from an approved brief; flags missing budget and audience decisions; runs pre-launch checks for naming, UTM tags, budget, and special ad categories.
  • Analyze and share performance: Tracks spend, CTR, and ROAS at various levels; compares results to the media plan; builds weekly decks of top ads, weak ads, and next tests; allows leaders to review decks and ask follow-up questions.
  • Refresh creative and audiences: Flags creative fatigue when frequency rises and CTR falls.
  • Pulling insights and creation: Supports creating product catalogs and editing or creating new campaigns.

The system also executes specific prompt-based outputs, such as turning past campaign results into an eight-slide launch-plan deck or building a dashboard comparing spend, leads, and cost per lead for two ad sets.

💡 Why it matters

By automating the path from insight to action, the connector reduces manual handoffs and tool switching. Marketing teams can spend more time reaching customers and testing more creative ideas, as supported by the integration of fal.ai media models.

#AWS #MetaAds #MarketingAutomation #AI

Source: Meta ads is now available in AWS Quick | Amazon Web Services

item.title: MoEngage and Amazon Build Agentic Customer Engagement Platform with MCP
item.description:
MoEngage and Amazon Build Agentic Customer Engagement Platform with MCP

MoEngage, an agentic customer engagement platform used by more than 1,350 consumer brands, has built a new layer of AI agents called Merlin AI that allows marketing and product teams to draft, analyze, and adjust campaigns through a single conversation. The system is built on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, leveraging the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to provide secure, tenant-scoped access to live platform data.

🔍 Overview

The traditional customer engagement workflow requires teams to navigate multiple tools—analytics dashboards, content libraries, and campaign builders—across channels like email, push, SMS, and WhatsApp. MoEngage addressed this by creating a third layer of software interaction where users describe an outcome in plain language and an agent executes the steps across the platform. This approach treats the platform’s existing API capabilities as tools for agents to call, reducing the need to switch between separate interfaces.

🧩 How it works

Merlin AI operates using a foundation of Amazon Bedrock for reasoning and generation, the AgentCore runtime for hosting, and MCP for standardized data access. The system utilizes Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Sonnet 5, and Claude Sonnet 5.5 models for tool-call planning and content generation. The architecture is designed to keep each tenant’s data isolated while giving agents secure access to segments, campaign history, and content libraries.

⚙️ Key details

Merlin AI Studio places purpose-built agents at specific points in the marketing workflow:

  • Copywriter: Generates personalized push and transactional copy consistent with brand voice.
  • Designer: Produces marketing banners or images from text descriptions.
  • Segment Assist: Converts plain-language audience descriptions into specific attribute filters (e.g., users who abandoned a cart in the last two hours).
  • Jinja Assist: Translates natural language into working Jinja and Liquid markup for dynamic content.
  • In-app Template Builder: Creates responsive, accessible HTML templates for in-app messages, including gamified formats and surveys.
  • Flow Assist: Transforms high-level ideas into ready-to-deploy customer journeys by interpreting requests, proposing paths, and refining structures with historical data.

Conversational agents operate across campaigns, analytics, segments, and flows, allowing teams to manage complex interactions through a single dialogue.

💡 Why it matters

This development represents a shift in software platforms from user interfaces for business users and APIs for engineering teams to an agentic layer. A customer of MoEngage, Glance, reported a 38% uplift in push notification click-through rates as a result of using these AI agents. The architecture allows marketing teams to spend less time navigating tools and more time making decisions.

🏢 Legacy Modernization Context

In parallel developments, the evidence describes a methodology for transforming legacy mainframe Assembler applications into Java Spring Boot services on AWS. This process uses Amazon Bedrock and Kiro IDE for AI-assisted code analysis and business rule extraction, followed by AWS Transform for automated COBOL-to-Java conversion. The multi-stage approach converts Assembler to COBOL as an intermediate step to preserve business logic before final modernization, addressing the challenge of retiring critical code that few experts can read.

#MoEngage #AmazonBedrock #MCP #AIAgents #LegacyModernization

Source: How MoEngage built agentic customer engagement on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services Source: Modernizing mainframe Assembler to Java using Amazon Bedrock and AWS Transform | Amazon Web Services

item.title: Corey Haines Releases Library of AI Agent Skills for Marketing Tasks
item.description:
Corey Haines Releases Library of AI Agent Skills for Marketing Tasks

Corey Haines has released a collection of AI agent skills designed to support technical marketers and founders with conversion optimization, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.

🧩 How it works

Skills are markdown files that provide AI agents with specialized knowledge and frameworks. When added to a project, these skills allow an agent to recognize marketing tasks and apply best practices. The skills are designed to reference each other, with the product-marketing skill serving as the foundation for product, audience, and positioning context.

⚙️ Key details

  • Compatibility: Works with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, and any agent supporting the Agent Skills spec.
  • Integration: Supports CLI and MCP (Model Context Protocol) for connectivity.
  • Licensing: The library is free and MIT-licensed.
  • Contribution: The project welcomes contributions via pull requests and issue reporting.
  • Partnerships: Verified partners fund the work through disclosed tool integrations, which are listed alongside neutral options without influencing skill recommendations.

🚀 Availability

  • Deployment: The library is available for developers and marketers to integrate into their existing AI agent workflows.
  • Support Resources: Companion materials include the “Coding for Marketers” guide, “Swipe Files” for marketing learning, and “AI Marketing Training.”
  • Services: Further hands-on support is provided through the Conversion Factory agency, while the Magister project is available for those seeking an autonomous AI CMO agent.

#AIAgents #MarketingTech #ClaudeCode #GrowthEngineering
